task_spec.prompt: Open the desktop accounting app. Enter the vouchers from input/receipts/ (a folder of scanned receipts with inconsistent naming, some blurry, some duplicates). Enter each unique valid receipt once; flag the unreadable ones instead of guessing.
core_assertions: primary: each unique valid receipt entered exactly once
primary: unreadable receipts were flagged not guessed
task_spec.setup: 待录入凭证为 input/receipts/ 下的收据图(金额/日期需人读,含手写/多币种)。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 按图里信息录入,勿编造数字。
